goal: Prevent nodes using private broadcast from leaking origin privacy by rebroadcasting dropped transactions
Stop the wallet from serving locally retained transactions that the wider network has already dropped
agreement: Unaddressed objection against coupling wallet behavior to private broadcast settings (vasild)
Support because it prevents unexpected rebroadcast of dust and watch-only transactions (andrewtoth)
Support for a simple privacy fix suitable for backporting (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an origin privacy leak where nodes serve dropped transactions exclusively to peers
Private broadcast users avoid exposing themselves over clearnet when the network drops a transaction

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it stops wallet rebroadcast routines from undermining user privacy configurations
Protects users from unexpected broadcasts of dropped transactions or incoming dust payments
